blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26224762 and Base block 52800567, canonical CADC deployments 0xcadc0acd4b445166f12d2c07eac6e2544fbe2eef (34.7741% of circulating supply) and 0x043eb4b75d0805c43d7c834902e335621983cf03 (61.8122%) resolve to FiatTokenV2_2 implementations 0x0c9b0169a23087a5edb566d4b1ea39b6b276332a and 0xdd022586a7700e2480838350554b0db8b9ff6502. blacklister() returns 0x3E30d340C83d068d632e11B5a30507ce973D7700 and 0x3de3405801F7f6a2fE348A365e07Dc4f83C7a6a8 respectively; paused() is false on both. The verified implementation exposes blacklist(address) gated by onlyBlacklister and enforces the blacklist on transfer/transferFrom, so both material deployments carry an active holder-targeted control. Polygon (2.7977%) and Arbitrum (0.6161%) are sub-threshold. The Solana SPL mint 9ewjJpmD1ES83RDRFnHs7V2hUdH76WAVjdvu6UV6WNo7 retained freezeAuthority 5qxWg4NfA6iUMNC4TqzFyWue3BE6bHZGEVu2sz2wbWvg at finalized slot 452218719; Solana is absent from the 2026-10-19 census chainShares and is disclosed as a sub-threshold control that does not set the verdict.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: CADC is a Canadian dollar stablecoin issued by Loon/Paytrie and made available on supported chains through direct network launches. I did not resolve a separate bridge, lockbox, or liquidity route for durable supply, so Pharos treats current route risk as native issuance on each deployment.
